verdict.rationale: Decagon's Agent Operating Procedures let ops teams define agent behavior in natural language 'the same way you train human agents with SOPs' (decagon-docs-16), and Duet/testing-qa let teams verify agents 'follow policies' (decagon-docs-11), which could be used to encode human-only topic rules, plus generic claims of 'full visibility and control over guardrails' (decagon-docs-1). But there is no explicit feature or documentation describing a dedicated human-only topic flag/escalation guarantee, nor any evidence (audit logs, enforcement tests) that the agent is prevented from ever engaging on flagged topics like legal threats or cancellations. Missing for 10: an explicit human-only/escalation-list feature, enforcement guarantees, and independent verification that flagged topics are never handled by the agent.
